name: BrowserOS Marketplace
description: The official BrowserOS marketplace: sandboxed apps and adoptable specs.

items.name: Welcome
items.description: A sample item demonstrating an adoptable spec and a sandboxed app.

items.name: Pomodoro
items.description: A focus timer with work/break cycles.

items.name: Color Palette
items.description: Generate color palettes (analogous, complementary, triadic, mono).

items.name: BOS App Starter
items.description: An adoptable starter spec for authoring a new sandboxed BrowserOS app.

items.name: Lunar Lander the classic game
items.description: Land a lunar lander on the moon

items.name: Terminal Service
items.description: WebSocket-based shell daemon — the reference/example service for user-specs/002-service-daemons, bundled with its own Terminal app under app/.

items.name: Workflow Manager
items.description: DAG-based workflow orchestration — multi-step automations that delegate to sub-agents. Execution runs on the main BOS process (src/lib/workflows/runner.ts); this service's Start/Stop state gates whether new runs are allowed.

items.name: Live Avatar
items.description: Lip-synced avatar powered by AVTR-1. Streams TTS audio to an avatar rendering server and displays the result as a live video in a BOS window.
